data.title: River Behavior Analysis
data.passage: Spring rainstorms fill mountain streams with rushing water very quickly. Similarly, heavy melting winter snow sends massive sheets of water down the valleys. However, low flat regions absorb much of this extra moisture into the deep soil. In contrast, rocky landscapes bounce the liquid right back into the overflowing riverbeds. Both situations require careful tracking by local weather stations. Farmers must watch water levels closely to protect their crops.
